note: Read by tests/run_ci.py. A suite fails CI when it prints a FAIL line not listed here, or exits non-zero without one (a crash). Entries match the start of a check's message exactly as the suite prints it after 'FAIL '. Keep this list short and specific: never add a pattern that could hide a new regression.

advisory._why: Reported in the summary, never block a deploy; every correctness check in the same suites stays blocking. Timing measurements (drag suites): they depend on the machine's speed and load (they fail when 15 browsers share 4 CPUs and pass alone); the landings, ranks 1..N, stale rows, scrolling stops at 0px, listeners and node counts stay blocking. Board-quality preferences (value_curve_check, Alan, Oct 14): a tier boundary under the preferred 3% gap and an adjacent value drop over 30% describe Alan's board, not the code, so they inform (the Review panel and the suite's own output list them) without overruling a ranking publish; values rising down the order, split or inverted tiers, stored values not shown as stored and page errors stay blocking.
drag_check: Grab restyles only the drag elements
A further drag lifts the row right away
drag_repeat_check: A drop redraws only the rows that changed
drag_scroll_check: Holding near the bottom edge scrolls
Five drags in a row scroll at the same speed
value_curve_check: Every tier boundary has a real value gap
